title: Customization Browse page
description: The Browse page of the Customizations editor when marketplace discovery is on (`chat.customizations.marketplace.enabled`): a rounded panel with the "Browse customizations" title, Add Customization menu button, description with Learn more, the marketplace search box (filter action) with the source picker (All Sources), and the scrolling list of discovery sections. Below 800px wide it switches to the single-column `.narrow` grid, like the product. The product's search box is a suggest-enabled Monaco input; here a plain input sits in the same container.
usage: Inside <vsc-customizations-editor> as the `section="browse"` page. Put discovery sections in the default slot (first one `featured` for Editor's picks).

attributes.name: description
attributes.default: Tailor your agent to your tools, your team, and your workflow.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.default: Search MCP servers, plugins, skills and more...

attributes.name: narrow
attributes.description: Force the narrow layout (single-column grid). Otherwise applied automatically below 800px like the product.

slots.description: Browse sections (<vsc-customization-discovery-section>) followed by flat search rows (<vsc-customization-discovery-result>). Typing switches from curated sections to the result list.

states.name: narrow
states.trigger: Container narrower than 800px: single-column browse grid.

states.name: searching
states.trigger: Typing switches from curated browse sections to the flat customization result list and fires `search` with the query.
